{{Quote|I was rather fond of Commander Appo.|Darth Vader, on Appo's death|<ref name="DL" />}}
'''Appo''', whose [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] designation was '''CC-1119''', was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the elite [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. He was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], where [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] used the [[DNA/Legends|genetic]] [[Clone template/Legends|template]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], to create a clone [[Army/Legends|army]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], CC-1119 received [[ARC program/Legends|training]] from the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha]], where he was given his name.

In late [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Appo, who was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone sergeant]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]], was part of a Republic [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] that was sent to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] planet [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. There, he saw firsthand [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell's]] high-attrition rate but carried out the [[General/Legends|general's]] orders until Krell's [[Treason/Legends|betrayal]]. In the war's [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]], Commander Appo led the 501st Legion in a Republic [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attack]] on the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. He served under [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during the Temple attack and later, when the Republic transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Appo and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|soldiers]] became some of the first Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and alongside Vader he worked to suppress threats against the Empire.

A [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the Empire's creation in 19 BBY, he and his men saved Vader's life in a Jedi ambush on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. In the following [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], Appo was stationed aboard Vader's [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Exactor/Legends|Exactor]]''. He helped Vader to hunt down a group of [[Ion Team|rogue clones]] who had aided the escape of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], then continued to aid Vader in the search for those Jedi. The chase took him from Murkhana to the Coruscant Jedi Temple to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where the path of the fugitive Jedi intersected that of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]]&mdash;a wanted man by the Empire&mdash;and at last to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. As the Empire [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|invaded]] that world later in the year, Appo accompanied Vader to the planet's surface in pursuit of the Jedi, only to be [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Roan Shryne]].

==Biography==
===Clone Wars===
====Early life and invasion of Umbara====
{{Quote|The platoons are in the formation you've requested, General. Should I send them to support Captain Rex?''"<br />"''I'll give the order when I give it, Sergeant Appo.|Appo and Pong Krell|<ref name="General">{{TCW|The General (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Appo501stUmbara-TG.png|thumb|left|300px|Appo relays Krell's command to attack the Umbaran airbase]]
CC-1119 was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] by [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] from the [[DNA/Legends|genetic]] [[Clone template/Legends|template]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on<ref name="Clone DB" /> the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. He would be apart of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] that would serve in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Clone DB" /> A special operations [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]],<ref name="DL" /> CC-1119 participated in the [[ARC program/Legends|ARC training program]] during the war run by [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha]], who stressed the importance of improvisational thinking and individuality. It was this emphasis on individualism that led to Alpha-17 bestowing names upon the graduates of his program; CC-1119 received the name "Appo."<ref name="Clone DB" />

In late [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Umbara date">{{FactFile2014|7|HEA 1-2|Z-95 Headhunter}} dates the events of the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]&mdash;which Appo fought in&mdash;to late [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Appo was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone sergeant]] that served in the Grand Army's [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="General" /> Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], Appo was part of a Republic [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] that was dispatched to<ref name="Darkness">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="Umbara">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the [[Umbara system/Legends|Umbara system]], and therefore the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].</ref> planet<ref name="Encyclopedia: Umbara">{{SWE|locations|umbara|Umbara}}</ref> [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]],<ref name="Darkness" /> a world that was once aligned with the Republic.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Umbara" /> After the initial attack on the stationed<ref name="Darkness" /> [[Umbaran soldier/Legends|Umbaran Soldiers]]<ref name="CWA Shop: Umbaran Soldier">{{TCWA|set=Umbaran Soldier}}</ref> of the [[Umbaran militia]],<ref name="Darkness EG">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep407|text="Darkness on Umbara" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> the 501st's [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] on the world, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], was relieved of his duties after the arrival of another [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]], a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]], who took over the command of the 501st Legion as an interim.<ref name="Darkness" />

====Taking the Umbaran airbase====
{{Quote|Sergeant, their defenses are down. Send in the rest of our forces. Attack the airbase.''"<br />"''All units, move out.|Pong Krell and Appo|<ref name="General" />}}
[[File:Appo-TCW-armor.png|thumb|right|220px|Appo's Phase II helmet had an arrow shaped symbol during the Battle of Umbara.]]
Under Krell's command, Appo stood by the general on the top of a cliff, while the other clone [[Squad/Legends|squads]], led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] CT-7567&mdash;named [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]&mdash;engaged the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]] in combat. After receiving the order of forming clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] from Krell, Appo obeyed the order and organized a number of clone platoons that consisted of clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] and [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]]-mounted troops.<ref name="General" />

As Rex and his men were taking causalities while battling<ref name="General" /> [[Umbaran mobile heavy cannon/Legends|Umbaran mobile heavy cannons]],<ref name="Umbaran MHC">{{SWE|technology|umbaranmhc|Umbaran MHC}}</ref> Appo informed Krell that his task of forming the platoons was complete. The [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] also wanted to send the troops to aid Rex on the battlefield, although Krell dismissed Appo, by stating he would give out the order of deploying the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. When Rex contacted Krell via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], Appo held the transmitting device in his hand while the general talked to the [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Rex informed Krell that he formulated a plan to infiltrate a nearby [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|Umbaran airbase]]. He dispatched two troopers&mdash;[[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]] and [[Fives/Legends|Fives]]&mdash;who would enter the base undetected and board separate [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]]. The use of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] would help them take out the attacking six-legged mobile cannons.<ref name="General" />

[[File:UmbaranAirbase-PoD.png|thumb|left|300px|Appo and the 501st successfully took the Umbaran airbase.]]
Though Krell did not support the idea, Rex, nevertheless, carried out his plan. As Hardcase and Fives left to infiltrate the airbase, Rex and the rest of his team stayed behind to continue their battle against the mobile cannons. On the cliff, both Appo and Krell witnessed the destruction of the mobile cannons after Hardcase and Fives arrived aboard two separate Umbaran starfighters. Noticing the airbase's defensive systems were down, Krell ordered Appo to mobilize his troops and attack the airbase. Appo's men took over the airbase, which forced the remaining Umbaran troops stationed there to surrender. With the airbase captured, Krell and the rest of the 501st Legion fortified themselves in the base.<ref name="General" />

====Krell's betrayal====
{{Quote|General Krell would like to see them in the tower.|Appo, to Rex about Fives and Jesse|<ref name="Plan" />}}
[[File:Appowithprisoners-COK.png|thumb|right|300px|Appo escorting Fives and Jesse]]
After Hardcase [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] himself by staying behind to destroy a [[Unidentified Separatist supply ship/Legends|Separatist supply ship]], Fives and [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] returned in their Umbaran starfighters to the airbase. Krell learned of the clones' actions, who told Appo to bring Fives and Jesse to him in the airbase's central command tower. Appo relayed the order to Fives and Jesse and the clones met with Krell in the tower. Krell informed the two clones that because they disobeyed a direct order, they would be [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] for their actions and be sent to the Grand Army's [[Court-martial/Legends|court-martial]].<ref name="Plan">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref>

Fives and Jesse were imprisoned and ready to be court-martialed, Krell changed his mind due to a court-martial's lengthy trial time. Instead, Krell decided to execute Fives and Jesse for their crimes. Rex, with Appo, was ordered to take the two clones outside so they could be executed by a firing squad. As Appo stood by the [[Stuncuffs/Legends|handcuffed]] Fives and Jesse, the firing squad prepared to shoot the two clones, although their concentration was cut off after Fives pleaded for them to rethink. Trooper [[Dogma/Legends|Dogma]], however, did not care for Fives' words and ordered the firing squad to fire on Fives and Jesse. Fives' words affected them, however, which caused them to misfire. Rex ordered Appo and another clone to take off Fives and Jesse's binders. However, on Krell's orders, the two clones were taken back to the airbase's prison.<ref name="Carnage" />

[[File:PongKrellSafeLanding-CoK.png|thumb|left|300px|Appo and the 501st successfully apprehended Krell.]]
When Krell's betrayal was revealed, Appo joined Rex and the clone troopers that went to the airbase's central tower to arrest Krell for [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Republic. Outside the airbase prison after Krell's capture, Appo briefed Rex on the airbase's [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] being successfully repaired after they found it was sabotaged by Krell, and Kenobi capturing the capital with the remaining Umbarans heading to the airbase. Rex ordered Appo to get the troops on the base's permeter in preparation for the Umbaran attack. Appo then acknowledged the order. After Krell's execution by Dogma, Appo and the rest of the 501st Legion regrouped outside the prison. The Republic had won the battle after Kenobi's forces mopped up the remaining Umbaran troops.<ref name="Carnage" />

===Order 66===
{{Quote|There's been a rebellion, sir. Don't worry. The situation is under control. I'm sorry, sir. It's time for you to leave.|Appo, barring Senator Organa from entering the Jedi Temple after Order 66|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
[[File:Appo_Jukassa.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Jukassa injures Appo at the Jedi Temple]]
By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="DL date" /> Appo became a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] and the leader of the 501st Legion.<ref name="DL" /> In that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="DL date" /> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] declared the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] enemies of the Republic and issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency order]] for the Republic's Grand Army. Appo led the 501st Legion [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|against]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], serving alongside the Chancellor's new apprentice Darth Vader, formerly Anakin Skywalker. Appo and his soldiers killed a number of Jedi that night.<ref name="DL" />

When [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] came to the Temple to investigate what had happened, Appo and several troopers met him on one of the Temple's landing platforms. Appo informed Organa that there had been a rebellion, but when Organa tried to enter the Temple, he drew his [[DC-15S/Legends|blaster]] upon the Senator and ordered him to leave. As Organa turned to go, a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Zett Jukassa/Legends|Zett Jukassa]], rushed onto the pad and began slashing at troopers with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="ROTS" /> Appo ordered his troops to open fire on Jukassa, only to be cut down<ref name="ROTSIS">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> at the [[Limb/Legends|lower leg]] by the Padawan.<ref name="ROTS" /> His fellow soldier Sergeant [[Fox (501st Legion)|Fox]] killed Jukassa,<ref name="O66">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref> but allowed Organa to escape.<ref name="GttGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> Jukassa's attack seriously wounded Appo,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|38|Appo, Clone Commander}}</ref> but he survived and recovered, later filing a report on the death of Jukassa and a number of other Jedi killed in the Temple.<ref name="O66" />

===Imperial service===
====Kessel, New Plympto, and Murkhana====
{{Quote|I was concerned we'd end up as glorified policemen. It's good to have a mission.''"<br />"''I hope you're right&mdash;because Lord Vader doesn't seem pleased.|Commanders Vill and Appo|<ref name="DT4">[[Dark Times 4|''Dark Times'' 4]]</ref>}}
[[File:App.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Appo speaks with Vader on Kessel]]
Following the execution of the Jedi Order, Chancellor Palpatine reorganized the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Appo's 501st Legion received a new name, as well: [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="DL" /> Approximately a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|declaration of the Empire]], Vader received word from [[Spy/Legends|spies]] that his former master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, was on<ref name="Purge">[[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']]</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet<ref name="Outer Rim">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]; against the orders of now-[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, he set off for that world. Unbeknownst to Vader, Palpatine dispatched Appo<ref name="Purge" /> and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bow (clone stormtrooper)|Bow]]<ref name="Bow">{{CSWECite|I|90|Bow, Commander}}</ref> to follow.<ref name="DL" />

This was fortunate for Vader&mdash;the intelligence about Kenobi had been bait for a trap laid by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shadday Potkin/Legends|Shadday Potkin]], and a group of Jedi waited on Kessel to kill him. Though Vader was able to slay several of them, including Potkin, the last three Jedi survivors&mdash;[[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]], [[Roblio Darté]], and [[Jastus Farr]]&mdash;combined their powers against Vader. Before they could kill him, Appo<ref name="Purge" /> and Bow<ref name="Bow" /> arrived and opened fire on the Jedi. After the clones executed the last of them, Appo informed Vader that Palpatine sought his presence.<ref name="Purge" /> It was during this time that Appo accompanied Vader aboard his [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Exactor/Legends|Exactor]]''<ref name="DL" /> to<ref name="DT4" /> the Core Worlds planet<ref name="Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]], where the Empire had been engaging in operations against [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. Working with Clone Commander [[Vill]], Appo oversaw the removal of forces from the world.<ref name="DT4" />

[[File:Appo_and_Vill.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Appo and Vill aboard the ''Exactor'']]
Shortly thereafter, Palpatine ordered the ''Exactor'' to<ref name="DT4" /> the Outer Rim world [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], following reports of surviving Jedi on that world. A squad of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] had refused to obey Order 66 and allowed their Jedi Generals to escape, and Appo and his stormtroopers accompanied Vader down to the planet's surface to deal with the situation. Commander [[Salvo (clone trooper)|Salvo]], the leader of the Imperial forces on the world, greeted Vader upon his arrival in front of a crowd of Separatist prisoners, then presented him with the bodies and lightsabers of three Jedi who the clones had killed. Vader passed the lightsabers onto Appo, then queried Salvo as to the location of the other three Jedi that had been assigned to Murkhana.<ref name="DL" />

Salvo informed him that they had escaped and brought forth the commando squad that had been responsible for letting them live, [[Ion Team]]. When Vader drew his own lightsaber and prepared to execute them, Ion Team opened fire; Vader killed two of the clones, and the other two fled into the forest. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] ordered Appo to pursue and bring them back alive. It was not long before the traitorous clones were apprehended; upon the return of Appo's men, Vader had Salvo load the Separatist prisoners onto a transport for transfer to an Imperial prison. While processing them, Appo noticed a discrepancy in the prisoner count and realized that two Jedi had escaped after disguising themselves as Separatists and hiding within the group. Vader decided to deal with the problem himself.<ref name="DL" />

====A crime lord and Sith holocrons====
{{Quote|Lord Vader, security reports that two humans have been found in a secret compartment beneath the ship's galley.''"<br />"''Interesting. Let's see what security has uncovered.|Appo and Vader, on the two uncovered humans|<ref name="DL" />}}
[[File:Exactor.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Appo was involved in the ''Exactor''{{'s}} efforts to find the ''Dead Ringer''.]]
Appo was unable to find any sign of the two Jedi, [[Roan Shryne]] and [[Olee Starstone]], but he did locate [[Cash Garrulan]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] with former ties to Shryne. Vader, Appo, and his troopers stormed Garrulan's offices south of [[Murkhana City]], and Vader was able to catch the escaping crime lord. Garrulan attempted to play dumb, but eventually admitted that Shryne had contacted him; however, he stated that he had refused to help and had turned Shryne's name over to the local [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. Appo verified his claim. Garrulan then suggested Vader look for a [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] named [[Bioto]], who he implied might smuggle out the Jedi in his ship, the ''[[Dead Ringer]]''. Appo reported that the ''Ringer'' had taken flight, and Vader ordered him to have the ''Exactor'' intercept the ship; the two then returned to the Star Destroyer.<ref name="DL" />

As Vader interrogated Bioto, Appo learned that two [[Human/Legends|humans]] had been found in one of the ''Ringer''{{'s}} smuggling compartments. Vader and Appo questioned them, learning they had been hired by Garrulan as a distraction. What they were being distracted from became obvious as Appo learned that a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] was launching from Murkhana and would pass through the space the ''Exactor'' had occupied before it had moved to intercept the ''Ringer''. Vader prepared to go after the CloakShape in his own personal starfighter and had Appo select his wingmen. He ordered the commander to destroy Garrulan's ship when the crime lord attempted to flee Murkhana. Vader was unsuccessful in his mission, though, and the fugitive Jedi escaped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the CloakShape. Garrulan was killed shortly thereafter.<ref name="DL" />

[[File:SithHolocron-FFp25.png|thumb|right|200px|Appo accompanied Vader to find Sith holocrons in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.]]
Appo returned with Vader to Coruscant, later accompanying him when Palpatine sent Vader to the Jedi Temple in search of [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]]. [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] and a crew of technicians came too, on their own mission, only to detect that Shryne was accessing Temple records from a remote site. One of Isard's technicians traced it to a [[Jaguada's moon|moon]]<ref name="DL" /> of the Outer Rim<ref name="Jaguada">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the [[Jaguada system/Legends|Jaguada system]], and therefore the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].</ref> planet [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]], and Appo relayed information on the location to Vader, including the fact that an [[Jaguada garrison|Imperial garrison]] was present on Jaguada. Vader had Appo order the [[Unidentified garrison commander (Jaguada)|garrison commander]] to pursue Shryne and his cohorts. The Jedi escaped nonetheless; Appo had the garrison find all possible hyperspace vectors for their ship, but they were unsuccessful in catching it.<ref name="DL" />

====Alderaan, Kashyyyk, and death====
{{Quote|Lord Vader, the conflict has begun. Theater commanders await your orders''"<br />"''Raise them, Commander, and join me in the situation room.|Appo and Vader, prior to the assault on Kashyyyk|<ref name="DL" />}}
[[File:Fangzar.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Appo was ordered to apprehend a fleeing ex-Senator Fang Zar.]]
In late 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="DL date" /> Vader and Appo's search would not be thwarted for long, though. Former Senator [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]] of<ref name="DL" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="Sern Prime">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the [[Sern Prime system/Legends|Sern Prime system]], and therefore the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Sern Prime/Legends|Sern Prime]], in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].</ref> world [[Sern Prime/Legends|Sern Prime]], who had opposed Palpatine's rise to power, had thwarted [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|Imperial orders]] to remain on Coruscant and fled the planet, finding refuge with Bail Organa on the Core World planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. When Palpatine learned that Zar had been in contact with a crime lord on Murkhana to arrange for passage off Alderaan, he concluded that Zar's escape plan was tied to Vader's Jedi fugitives and sent Vader to deal with Zar. Appo and his stormtroopers accompanied Vader on his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to the planet's surface and stood by as Vader ordered Organa to turn over Zar. Organa prepared to comply, but they soon learned that Zar had fled his quarters. Vader sent Appo in pursuit of the former senator and headed off on his own to find Zar, while Organa dispatched his men with the same goal. Vader reached Zar first and executed him as the senator attempted to flee.<ref name="DL" />

Though Vader encountered Shryne on Alderaan, the Jedi escaped yet again; Palpatine soon informed Vader that Shryne and the party of Jedi survivors that he had gathered were headed for the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Some [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, Vader and Appo traveled to that world in the ''Exactor''. Vader met with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] aboard Tarkin's ship [[Executrix/Legends|''Executrix'']]; there, Tarkin informed Vader that the Jedi ship had been spotted arriving on Kashyyyk, then told Vader of the plan that he and Palpatine had devised. Tarkin would use the presence of Jedi on Kashyyyk as a pretense to [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|invade the planet]] and enslave the native Wookiees as enemies of the Empire.<ref name="DL" />

Appo and Vader supervised the initial part of the invasion from the bridge of the ''Exactor''; the commander summoned the officers in charge of the various theaters of battle to meet with the Dark Lord, then joined them as Vader briefed the group. Once the officers were clear on their duties, Vader and Appo descended to the surface of Kashyyyk to take on the Jedi. As they landed, Vader was informed over the [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] by one of the officers that the Wookiees were fleeing into the safety of Kashyyyk's forest and would soon become impossible to root out. Appo suggested that they initiate surgical [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardments]] to flush the Wookiees out, and Vader gave the order to do so.<ref name="DL" />

[[File:BattleofKashyyyk-ImperialEra.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Appo's 501st on Kashyyyk]]
When the shuttle touched down, Appo and his stormtroopers rushed out, Vader right behind them. A heavy firefight with the Wookiees ensued, and several of Appo's stormtroopers fell. Vader dealt with the Wookiees and waved Appo forward, only to have several of the Jedi fugitives step out and meet them in combat, some engaging Vader and some Appo. As Vader killed those attacking him, the Jedi fighting Appo withdrew and set their sights on the Dark Lord, only to be slain in turn. At last only Olee Starstone remained, and Vader ordered Appo and his men to leave her to him and deal with the last few surviving Wookiees. 

A new ship arrived next to the stormtroopers, though, with Roan Shryne on board. Shryne used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to pull one of the fallen Jedi's lightsabers to him, and with it he [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] Appo.<ref name="DL" /> 501st Commander Bow filed a [[Casualty Report: Order 66|report]] on Appo's death.<ref name="O66" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Good work, Commander.|Darth Vader, to Appo|<ref name="DL" />}}
[[File:Appo.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Appo, during Operation: Knightfall]]
Appo was a Human [[Gender/Legends|male]] with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and tan skin<ref name="Carnage" /> who had a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Appo DB" /> During CC-1119's training under Alpha-17, the commander developed his sense of individuality, learning how to apply it to combat situations.<ref name="Clone DB" /> Appo was constantly ready to relay or obey his superior's commands, and sometimes even took the initiative to seek out some piece of intelligence before his superior asked for it.<ref name="DL" /> During the Clone Wars, Appo demonstrated this on Umbara, where he obeyed orders given to him by his commanding officer, Krell.<ref name="General" /> After the Republic transformed into the Empire, Appo was concerned that his role would be downgraded to law enforcement and was grateful to be assigned actual missions.<ref name="DT4" />

In his service to the Empire, Appo had an easy relationship with his superior Darth Vader. Though the black armor that Vader covered himself in often inspired fear in others, to Appo it was only natural that Vader should protect himself from harm. Vader, in turn, felt more at ease around Appo and his soldiers, and after the commander's death even expressed a certain fondness for the man. Vader kept Appo at his side much of the time, sometimes asking for the commander's analysis of military matters. The two could communicate with each other wordlessly, Appo easily understanding and carrying out Vader's commands that consisted of a simple nod of the head or gesture of the hand.<ref name="DL" />

==Equipment==
Appo wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] that sported the blue markings of the 501st Legion.<ref name="ROTS" /> Originally around the second year of the war, Appo's helmet featured an arrow symbol,<ref name="General" /> although it was removed by Operation: Knightfall.<ref name="ROTS" /> After Order 66, Appo's set featured a tan [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]], a blast-dampening tan [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']], and a white [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]].<ref name="DT4" /> Appo also had a blue and black pauldron and bandolier.<ref name="Rebelscum">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=#064: Commander Appo|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TSC064appo.asp}}</ref> In combat, Appo wielded a DC-15S [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]],<ref name="ROTS" /> a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]],<ref name="Plan" /> or dual [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]].<ref name="DT4" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Origins===
[[File:Appo_Pauldron.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Commander Appo after Order 66]]
The clone trooper simultaneously first appeared in [[Matthew Stover]]'s [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]] and [[George Lucas]]' [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']], which were both released on [[April 2]], [[2005]]. The former source had the clone trooper unnamed while the name "Appo" and numerical designation "1119" were identified in the latter source.<ref name="Release date">The [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]&mdash;both establishing the character&mdash;were simultaneously released on [[April 2]], [[2005]].</ref> Appo was first pictured in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 3|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' 3]],<ref name="Episode III comic">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 3|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' 3]]</ref> which was written by [[Christopher Cerasi]] under the pseudonym Miles Lane,<ref name="Epic Collection">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: The Clone Wars Vol. 4]]''</ref> illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[April 13]], 2005.<ref name="Comic date">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/13-197/Star-Wars-Episode-III----Revenge-of-the-Sith-3|text=Star Wars: Episode III -- Revenge of the Sith #3}}</ref>

Appo made his live action debut in George Lucas' film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which was released on [[May 19]], 2005.<ref name="ROTS" /> With his voice provided by [[Temuera Morrison]], Appo, like all clone troopers in the movie, was portrayed entirely with computer-generated imagery.<ref name="Clone DB" /> The clone trooper's full numerical designation "CC-1119" was introduced in [[Daniel Wallace]]'s [[2006]] "[[Order 66: Destroy All Jedi]]" reference article of [[Star Wars Insider 87|''Star Wars Insider'' 87]].<ref name="O66" /> [[Dee Bradley Baker]] later voiced Appo in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episodes "[[The General (episode)|The General]],"<ref name="General" /> "[[Plan of Dissent]],"<ref name="Plan" /> and "[[Carnage of Krell]]."<ref name="Carnage" /> The arrow on Appo's helmet in ''The Clone Wars'' is an acknowledgment to Baker voicing Appa, a character from the [[W:c:avatar:Avatar: The Last Airbender|''Avatar: The Last Airbender'']] television series in which supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] had previously worked on.<ref name="The General Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-general-trivia|text="The General" Trivia Gallery}}</ref>

===Inconsistencies===
{{Quote|Commander Bow is new, invented for this article ''["Order 66: Destroy All Jedi"]'' when I realized that I couldn't have the headless body of Commander Appo file the paperwork on Roan Shryne.|Daniel Wallace, on having to create a new character in place of Appo|<ref name="JC">{{JCFCite|url=posts/23620481|board=Literature|thread="Order 66 Destroy All Jedi" by Daniel Wallace (SWI #87)|user=[[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]]|date=2006-04-09|time=8:19 PM|archivedate=20200418183101}}</ref>}}
There is confusion over the identity of Appo in many of his appearances. Episode III includes a number of clone troopers who meet with Bail Organa on the landing platform of the Jedi Temple.<ref name="ROTS" /> The script identifies the trooper who speaks with Organa and raises his gun as a "Clone Sergeant," with Appo stated to be a separate trooper who says "Take care of him."<ref name="HS">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/87/indexp2.html|text=The Original Order of Order 66}}</ref> The Episode III novelization agrees with this version, establishing both a clone sergeant who speaks with Organa and an unnamed commander who says Appo's lines.<ref name="Episode III novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> However, an official poster of Appo given out at [[Wikipedia:Comic-Con International|Comic-Con]] in 2006 identifies him as the clone who speaks with Organa&mdash;the "Clone Sergeant" character.<ref name="CC">{{SWArchive|url=collecting/news/misc/news20060621.html|text=Your Guide to Comic-Con ''Star Wars'' Exclusives}}</ref> In the movie, it is unclear which clone speaks the line ascribed to Appo in the script; the above article therefore treats the Comic-Con poster as the correct identification of Appo.

Zett Jukassa's role in this scene introduces another complication. According to "Order 66: Destroy All Jedi," Jukassa injures Appo, and the script of the movie states this as well&mdash;identifying Appo as the clone who orders the troopers to take care of Organa.<ref name="O66" /> While the movie, as mentioned above, does not make clear which trooper is Appo, the clone who confronts Organa is amongst those injured by Jukassa.<ref name="ROTS" /> The novel, however, has Appo still uninjured after Jukassa is dead,<ref name="Episode III novel" /> and the Episode III comic adaptation has no troopers&mdash;including the one who speaks with Organa&mdash;injured by Jukassa.<ref name="Episode III comic" />

When Daniel Wallace wrote "Order 66: Destroy All Jedi," he created the character of Commander Bow when he realized that filing the paperwork on Roan Shryne's death could not be done by Appo's acephalous body.<ref name="JC" /> Another case of identity confusion arose with ''[[Purge (comic book)|Star Wars: Purge'']], however, which includes an unnamed commander of the 501st serving under Vader.<ref name="Purge" /> Because [[Lucasfilm]] had not decided on the relative timeline placements of ''Purge'' and ''Dark Lord'', Wallace had Bow report on the events of ''Purge'', while not making explicit whether the commander in the comic was Bow or Appo.<ref name="JC" /> When [[Hasbro]] created a figure of Appo, however, they established him as the commander in ''Purge''.<ref name="Rebelscum" />
